cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Raise the Stakes
cards.instruction: Persuade them to accept a larger risk, cost, or commitment so the outcome will feel decisive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put your club captaincy on the rematch. I coached you through your first game; I'd like one result you can't shrug off afterward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're recognising a real stake now. Good. If I win, I captain the next match; if you win, I stop telling you how to lead it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We've both forgotten the scores of six games for pride. Put the captain's badge between us. You can defend it without asking your old coach to lower the stakes.
